QUOTE: "with the shipped defaults, mbedtls creates no threads and takes no mutexes." Also: "The index found four spawn sites, all in `programs/`... This program needs `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under default config. It only notes the program needs those options.
